zh-CN.title: 链接卡片重新贴边
items: 修复宽屏下链接卡片偏离消息边缘的问题
无图卡片会按内容自然收缩
不同宽度的网页卡片保持同一侧对齐

en.title: Link cards stay aligned
items: Fixed link cards drifting away from message edges on wide screens
Cards without images now size naturally to their content
Web previews of different widths remain anchored consistently
